_schema_notes.Submission: id, userId, level, score, data(text/json: timeTaken secs, attempts), createdAt
_schema_notes.User: id, username, email, name, grade, role, schoolId
_schema_notes.exclude_schools: Tarcin | ABC Matriculation School | XYZ Higher Secondary School

filters.zones: SELECT id, name AS zone FROM "School" WHERE name NOT IN ('Tarcin','ABC Matriculation School','XYZ Higher Secondary School') ORDER BY name ASC

summary.totalStudents: SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS total FROM "User" u JOIN "School" sc ON u."schoolId" = sc.id WHERE sc.name NOT IN ('Tarcin','ABC Matriculation School','XYZ Higher Secondary School')
summary.participationRate: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT s."userId") / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "User" WHERE "schoolId" IS NOT NULL), 0), 2) AS rate FROM "Submission" s JOIN "User" u ON s."userId" = u.id JOIN "School" sc ON u."schoolId" = sc.id WHERE sc.name NOT IN ('Tarcin','ABC Matriculation School','XYZ Higher Secondary School')
summary.totalSubmissions: SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS total FROM "Submission" s JOIN "User" u ON s."userId" = u.id JOIN "School" sc ON u."schoolId" = sc.id WHERE sc.name NOT IN ('Tarcin','ABC Matriculation School','XYZ Higher Secondary School')
summary.totalScore: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.score),0)::bigint AS total FROM "Submission" s JOIN "User" u ON s."userId" = u.id JOIN "School" sc ON u."schoolId" = sc.id WHERE sc.name NOT IN ('Tarcin','ABC Matriculation School','XYZ Higher Secondary School') AND s.score IS NOT NULL

zonePerformance: SELECT sc.name AS zone, COUNT(DISTINCT u.id)::int AS student_count, COUNT(s.id)::int AS submissions, COALESCE(SUM(s.score), 0)::bigint AS total_score FROM "School" sc LEFT JOIN "User" u ON u."schoolId" = sc.id LEFT JOIN "Submission" s ON s."userId" = u.id WHERE sc.name NOT IN ('Tarcin','ABC Matriculation School','XYZ Higher Secondary School') AND ($1::text IS NULL OR sc.name = $1::text) GROUP BY sc.id, sc.name ORDER BY total_score DESC NULLS LAST
progressBands: WITH student_totals AS (SELECT sc.name AS zone, u.id AS student_id, COALESCE(SUM(s.score),0) AS total_score FROM "School" sc LEFT JOIN "User" u ON u."schoolId" = sc.id AND u.role = 'STUDENT' LEFT JOIN "Submission" s ON s."userId" = u.id WHERE sc.name NOT IN ('Tarcin','ABC Matriculation School','XYZ Higher Secondary School') AND ($1::text IS NULL OR sc.name = $1::text) GROUP BY sc.name, u.id) SELECT zone, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE student_id IS NOT NULL AND total_score = 0)::int AS no_submission_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE total_score > 0 AND total_score < 300)::int AS emerging_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE total_score >= 300 AND total_score < 1000)::int AS progressing_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE total_score >= 1000)::int AS advanced_count FROM student_totals GROUP BY zone ORDER BY (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE total_score >= 1000)) DESC, (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE total_score >= 300 AND total_score < 1000)) DESC, zone ASC
scoringBreakdown: SELECT sc.name AS zone, COALESCE(SUM(s.score), 0)::bigint AS total_score, ROUND(SUM(GREATEST(0, COALESCE((s.data::jsonb->>'attempts')::numeric, 1) - 1) * 5.0)::numeric, 2) AS total_wrong_deduction, ROUND(SUM((COALESCE((s.data::jsonb->>'timeTaken')::numeric, 0) / 60.0) * 3.0)::numeric, 2) AS total_time_deduction, 0.0 AS total_hint_deduction, COUNT(*)::int AS submissions FROM "Submission" s JOIN "User" u ON s."userId" = u.id JOIN "School" sc ON u."schoolId" = sc.id WHERE s.score IS NOT NULL AND sc.name NOT IN ('Tarcin','ABC Matriculation School','XYZ Higher Secondary School') AND ($1::text IS NULL OR sc.name = $1::text) GROUP BY sc.id, sc.name ORDER BY total_score DESC NULLS LAST
zoneScoreRanges: WITH zone_totals AS (SELECT sc.name AS zone, COALESCE(SUM(s.score), 0) AS total_score FROM "School" sc LEFT JOIN "User" u ON u."schoolId" = sc.id LEFT JOIN "Submission" s ON s."userId" = u.id WHERE sc.name NOT IN ('Tarcin','ABC Matriculation School','XYZ Higher Secondary School') AND ($1::text IS NULL OR sc.name = $1::text) GROUP BY sc.id, sc.name) SELECT zone, total_score, CASE WHEN total_score < 5000 THEN '0 – 5K' WHEN total_score < 20000 THEN '5K – 20K' WHEN total_score < 50000 THEN '20K – 50K' WHEN total_score < 100000 THEN '50K – 100K' WHEN total_score < 250000 THEN '100K – 250K' WHEN total_score < 500000 THEN '250K – 500K' ELSE '500K+' END AS score_range FROM zone_totals ORDER BY total_score DESC NULLS LAST
topStudents: SELECT COALESCE(u.name, u.username) AS student_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.grade,''),'Unknown') AS grade, sc.name AS school, COALESCE(SUM(s.score),0)::bigint AS total_score FROM "User" u JOIN "School" sc ON u."schoolId" = sc.id LEFT JOIN "Submission" s ON s."userId" = u.id WHERE u.role = 'STUDENT' AND sc.name NOT IN ('Tarcin','ABC Matriculation School','XYZ Higher Secondary School') AND ($1::text IS NULL OR sc.name = $1::text) GROUP BY u.id, u.name, u.username, u.grade, sc.name HAVING COALESCE(SUM(s.score),0) > 0 ORDER BY total_score DESC NULLS LAST, student_name ASC
topPerformingZones: WITH zone_stats AS (SELECT sc.name AS zone, COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS total_members, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.id IS NOT NULL THEN u.id END) AS active_members, COALESCE(SUM(s.score), 0)::bigint AS total_score FROM "School" sc LEFT JOIN "User" u ON u."schoolId" = sc.id LEFT JOIN "Submission" s ON s."userId" = u.id WHERE sc.name NOT IN ('Tarcin','ABC Matriculation School','XYZ Higher Secondary School') GROUP BY sc.id, sc.name) SELECT z.zone, z.total_members::int, z.active_members::int, (z.total_members - z.active_members)::int AS inactive_members, ROUND(100.0 * z.active_members / NULLIF(z.total_members, 0), 1) AS activity_rate, z.total_score FROM zone_stats z WHERE ($1::text IS NULL OR LOWER(z.zone) = LOWER($1::text)) ORDER BY z.total_score DESC NULLS LAST
